title: Rear yard on a short block (ZR 23-344(b) and (c)(3)) in the engine: a block-frontage measure between bounding streets on each basis (spatial/site_geometry/block_frontage.py), the (b)/(c)(3) checks combined with (a) in rear_yard_checks.py, 1.5.0 rear-yard + input_facts emission with the conditional version bump, the appendix open-item 1.5.0 text moved to readers.py, the G-5 benchmark + the two synthetic 1.5.0 fixtures regenerated from the corrected engine, the G-6 engine-side zoning-lot isolation, and the DB-245 ONE GIS-wording sweep (gis = 'city map outline', never 'tax map'). NB-01 revision 5; NB-03 revision 3; NB-05 code identity.
objective: Add the short-block rear-yard analysis to the scenario engine, behaviour-identical elsewhere on 1.4.0. (1) G-6 engine-side zoning-lot isolation: move _zoning_lot_scope_statement and _apply_zoning_lot_scope_row (three_way_document.py:725,:772) into a new three_way_zoning_lot.py, and the zoning-lot cluster _CITATION_STATE_BY_INDEX/_MONTHS/_human_date/_lot_label/_join_lots/zoning_lot_citation (result_way_bridge.py:107-205, NOT the :206+ dataclasses) into a new result_way_zoning_lot.py, with facades so three_way_document.py and result_way_bridge.py keep importing the names (call site result_way_bridge.py:511 unchanged); the moves must NET-SHRINK result_ways.py (~622 SLOC) and three_way_document.py (~679 SLOC), both already above the 600 WARN line; NB-01 revision 5 records the code identity and the G1 isolation decision. (2) A block-frontage measure on street S between its two bounding streets, on each measurement basis, never mixing bases, in a new spatial/site_geometry/block_frontage.py (sibling of frontage.py/depth.py/adjacency.py/live_streets.py), using a street window of at least 230 ft plus half the widths (coverage checked at G1; benchmark centreline separation ~260 ft), at most one added request (live_streets.py / mappluto_window_arcgis.py scope-note docstring only). (3) The (b) and (c)(3) checks in a new scenario/three_answers/rear_yard_checks.py with three states (applies->Conditional; not applicable; not known), combined with the (a) corner waiver and naming each check. (4) Emit the 1.5.0 rear_yard block, the (b) 100-ft line and input_facts (nine bases); add the conditional version-bump following three_way_document.py:121 so a document carrying any 1.5.0 block declares 1.5.0 and one carrying none keeps its version. (5) Build the appendix open-item 1.5.0 rear-yard text in readers.py (moved here by M5-T175's 2026-10-14 scope correction; readers.py ~475 SLOC, headroom): it reads the document's own rear_yard state/way/text and 23-344(b)/(c)(3) conditions, and stays byte-identical to M5-T165's REAR_YARD_OPEN_CHECK wording on a 1.4.0 document (page 8, R136). (6) Replace the fixed texts at first_option_results.py:121 and :509 from the check. (7) Fix the stale register entry (register.json r6b, interpretation :2587, title :2558 broadened to (a)/(b)/(c)(3)) and the rule file (kept as r6b_rear_yard_corner_waiver.rule.json, scope broadened; no rename); promote NB-03 to rev 3 (the only W25 research_status change, G-13). (8) Regenerate the whole G-5 benchmark set AND the two synthetic 1.5.0 fixtures from the corrected engine (R039): the recorded journey gains rear_yard+input_facts and flips to 1.5.0; the two synthetics are re-derived so their shared 1.4.0 core carries the new DB-245 wording, their DB-262 input_facts corrected (9,800->10,075; 10,120.5->10,387.99), their rear_yard_100ft_line geometry (0->182.5) KEPT so M5-T175's accepted test_constraint_overlay.py clip test stays green and unedited; test_results_contract_1_5_0.py's test_new_valid_fixture_is_journey_plus_only_the_new_blocks is reworked to strip the 1.5.0 blocks from BOTH the synthetic and the journey and compare the shared 1.4.0 cores, with :191 asserting the journey now declares 1.5.0. Plus the DB-245 GIS-wording sweep (ONE sweep): the GIS outline is 'city map outline', never 'tax map'/'tax-map outline', across the engine rendered texts (three_way_scope_lines.py:121/125/141; result_ways.py:177; result_way_bridge.py:355/360/366/372; result_way_conditions.py:187/199/202/212/215/474; options.py:45), and the measurement-RANK DISPLAY LABEL 'Approximate - tax map' renamed consistently at inputs.py:235 (drives geometry.measurement.label and the kit site-plan caption), report/readers.py:505 (_BASIS_NAMES), cad/results_dxf_notes.py:67, web three-answers.ts:592/:608, AND the sync twins profile/measurement.py:65 and drawings/kit/scope.py:88 (both carry the same rank label and are kept in step with the card/drawing); page_site_context.py needs NO code edit (its tax-map hits at :33/:214 are comments; the caption flows from the engine label via site_plan.py:337/kit adapter.py:91 and regenerates with the benchmark); the schema enum CODE 'approximate_tax_map' and the legitimate basis 'printed tax map' are NOT renamed; the provenance sentence three_way_document.py:220 and the exact rename-vs-keep string set (incl. the profile/kit sync and the rank-label wording) are pinned at G0. Expected values come only from the M5-T176 R6B reference case and the law, never program output; the benchmark rear-yard answer is not known/Conditional under both Z1 and Z2 (no unconditional 'no rear yard'; 23-344(b) linked).
business_reason: D-094 R036/R037/R079/R136 (reviewer next pass + the owner's forwarded review of 2026-10-14): page 6 omitted the separate short-block-frontage exception ZR 23-344(b) and page 8 still prints 'not yet checked'; it needs an explicit engine applicability check feeding the result and the report, and the report/website/CAD must stop calling the GIS city-map outline a 'tax map' (DB-245).
